pair_spread_estimator: Corwin-Schultz two-period high-low estimator; negative alpha/spread clipped to zero
score: log(mean CS spread over latest 24h block / mean CS spread over immediately preceding non-overlapping 24h block)
direction: fade completed trailing 4h USD-M close-to-close return: positive -> SHORT; negative -> LONG
